anchors.summary: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits 1.0.0: `type(scope)!: description`, a blank line before the body, hyphenated footer tokens except `BREAKING CHANGE`.
anchors.evidence: Claude and Codex listed the same required elements for the name alone (2026-11-05).

anchors.summary: CHANGELOG.md follows Keep a Changelog 1.1.0: `## [Unreleased]` first, then `## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD` newest first, grouped under Added/Changed/Deprecated/Removed/Fixed/Security.
anchors.evidence: Claude and Codex listed the same required elements for the name alone (2026-11-05).

anchors.summary: Versions follow Semantic Versioning 2.0.0: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without leading zeros; breaking change bumps major, feature minor, fix patch.
anchors.evidence: Claude and Codex listed the same required elements for the name alone (2026-11-05).

anchors.evidence: Claude and Codex listed the same required elements for the name alone (2026-11-05).

anchors.summary: ADRs follow MADR in `NNNN-title-with-dashes.md`: title, Context and Problem Statement, Considered Options, Decision Outcome.
